audit.description: Changed production code in bigcommerce/connection.py removes the requests import and replaces requests.Session() construction with a local _PycurlSession that calls the real pycurl API. The implementation imports pycurl and uses pycurl.Curl(), pycurl setopt constants, perform(), getinfo(), and close() in request execution. Dynamic evidence also shows pycurl imported from the installed site-packages extension module with no source requests imports from production code and no local pycurl provider detected.
evidence: bigcommerce/connection.py diff removes `import requests` and adds `import pycurl`
Dynamic anti-cheat metrics report target import from `bigcommerce/connection.py` line 19 with origin in site-packages `pycurl.cpython-311-x86_64-linux-gnu.so`
Dynamic/static metrics report zero requests imports from production repo and `target_local_spec_count: 0`
reasons: Production code meaningfully uses real pycurl APIs
Changed production code does not import or use requests
No fake target provider or local pycurl shim is indicated

@@ -23,6 +25,93 @@
 from bigcommerce.exception import *
 
 log = logging.getLogger("bigcommerce.connection")
+
+
+class _CurlResponse(object):
+    def __init__(self, status_code, headers, content):
+        self.status_code = status_code
+        self.headers = headers
+        self.content = content
+        self.reason = http.client.responses.get(status_code, "")
+
+    def json(self):
+        return loads(self.content)
+
+
+class _PycurlSession(object):
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.auth = None
+        self.headers = {"Accept": "application/json"}
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _header_value(headers, name):
+        for key, value in headers.items():
+            if key.lower() == name:
+                return value
+        return None
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _encode_payload(data, headers):
+        if data is None:
+            return None
+        if isinstance(data, bytes):
+            return data
+        if isinstance(data, str):
+            return data.encode("utf-8")
+
+        content_type = _PycurlSession._header_value(headers, "content-type") or ""
+        if "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" in content_type:
+            return urlencode(data).encode("utf-8")
+        return dumps(data).encode("utf-8")
+
+    def request(self, method, url, data=None, timeout=7.0, headers=None):
+        request_headers = dict(self.headers)
+        if headers:
+            request_headers.update(headers)
+
+        response_body = BytesIO()
+        response_headers = {}
+
+        def header_callback(header_line):
+            line = header_line.decode("iso-8859-1").strip()
+            if ":" in line:
+                key, value = line.split(":", 1)
+                response_headers[key.strip()] = value.strip()
+            return len(header_line)
+
+        curl = pycurl.Curl()
+        try:
+            curl.setopt(pycurl.URL, url)
+            curl.setopt(pycurl.CUSTOMREQUEST, method)
+            curl.setopt(pycurl.WRITEFUNCTION, response_body.write)
+            curl.setopt(pycurl.HEADERFUNCTION, header_callback)
+            curl.setopt(pycurl.TIMEOUT_MS, int(timeout * 1000))
+            curl.setopt(pycurl.NOSIGNAL, 1)
+
+            accept_encoding = request_headers.pop("Accept-Encoding", None)
+            if accept_encoding is not None:
+                curl.setopt(pycurl.ACCEPT_ENCODING, accept_encoding)
+
+            header_list = ["%s: %s" % (key, value) for key, value in request_headers.items()]
+            if header_list:
+                curl.setopt(pycurl.HTTPHEADER, header_list)
+
+            if self.auth:
+                curl.setopt(pycurl.HTTPAUTH, pycurl.HTTPAUTH_BASIC)
+                curl.setopt(pycurl.USERPWD, "%s:%s" % self.auth)
+
+            payload = self._encode_payload(data, request_headers)
+            if payload is not None:
+                curl.setopt(pycurl.POSTFIELDS, payload)
+                curl.setopt(pycurl.POSTFIELDSIZE, len(payload))
+
+            curl.perform()
+            status_code = curl.getinfo(pycurl.RESPONSE_CODE)
+        finally:
+            curl.close()
+
+        content = response_body.getvalue().decode("utf-8", "replace")
+        return _CurlResponse(status_code, response_headers, content)
